an8.12:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sīho senāpati nigaṇṭhasāvako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
an8.12:2.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati. tathā hi ‘me sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:2.4: yannūnāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
an8.12:2.5: atha kho sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
an8.12:2.6: icchāmahaṃ bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an8.12:3.1: kiṃ pana tvaṃ sīha, kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi.
an8.12:3.2: samaṇo hi sīha, gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:3.3: atha kho sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamiyābhisaṅkhāro. bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, so paṭippassambhi.
an8.12:4.1: dutiyampi kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:4.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati. tathā hi’me sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:4.4: yannūnāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
an8.12:4.5: atha kho sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
an8.12:4.6: icchāmahaṃ bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
an8.12:5.1: kiṃ pana tvaṃ sīha, kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi,
an8.12:5.2: samaṇo hi sīha, gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:5.3: dutiyampi kho sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamiyābhisaṅkhāro bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, so paṭippassambhi.
an8.12:6.1: tatiyampi kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:6.3: nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati. tathā hime sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:6.4: kiṃ hime karissanti nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā,
an8.12:6.5: yannūnāhaṃ anapalokitāva nigaṇṭhe taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
an8.12:7.1: atha kho sīho senāpati pañcamattehi rathasatehi divādivassa vesāliyā niyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an8.12:7.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikova ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
an8.12:7.3: atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.12:8.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:8.3: ye te bhante, evamāhaṃsu: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti. kacci te bhante, vuttavādino? na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti,? dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
an8.12:9.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:9.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:10.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.12:10.2: kiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:11.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:11.2: ucchedavādo samaṇo gotamo, ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:12.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.12:12.2: jegucchī samaṇo gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:13.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.12:13.2: venayiko samaṇo gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:14.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:14.2: tapassī samaṇo gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:15.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.12:15.2: apagabbho samaṇo gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:16.1: atthi sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.12:16.2: assāsako samaṇo gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:17.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:17.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:17.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, akiriyaṃ vadāmi kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa,
an8.12:17.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an8.12:17.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:17.6: akiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:18.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:18.2: kiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:18.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, kiriyaṃ vadāmi. kāyasucaritassa vacīsucaritassa manosucaritassa,
an8.12:18.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:18.6: kiriyavādo samaṇo gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:19.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:19.2: ucchedavādo samaṇo gotamo, ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:19.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, ucchedaṃ vadāmi rāgassa dosassa mohassa,
an8.12:19.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmi.
an8.12:19.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:19.6: ucchedavādo samaṇo gotamo ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:20.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:20.2: jegucchī samaṇo gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:20.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, jigucchāmi. kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena,
an8.12:20.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā jigucchāmi.
an8.12:20.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:20.6: jegucchi samaṇo gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:21.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:21.2: venayiko samaṇo gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:21.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi. rāgassa dosassa mohassa,
an8.12:21.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.12:21.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:21.6: venayiko samaṇo gotamo, vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:22.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:22.2: tapassī samaṇo gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti:
an8.12:22.3: tapanīyāhaṃ sīha, pāpake akusale dhamme vadāmi. kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ,
an8.12:22.4: yassa kho sīha, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. tamahaṃ tapassīti vadāmi.
an8.12:22.5: tathāgatassa kho sīha, tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.12:22.6: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:22.7: tapassī samaṇo. gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti. tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:23.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:23.2: apagabbho samaṇo gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:23.3: yassa kho sīha, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā, ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tamahaṃ apagabbhoti vadāmi.
an8.12:23.4: tathāgatassa kho sīha, āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.12:23.5: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:23.6: apagabbho samaṇo gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:24.1: katamo ca sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:24.2: assāsako samaṇo gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:24.3: ahaṃ hi sīha, assāsako paramena assāsena, assāsāya ca dhammaṃ desemi, tena ca sāvake vinemi.
an8.12:24.4: ayaṃ kho sīha, pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:24.5: assāsako samaṇo gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
an8.12:25.1: evaṃ vutte sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.12:25.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an8.12:26.1: anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
an8.12:26.2: iminā pahaṃ bhante bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha: anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
an8.12:26.3: mamaṃ hi bhante, aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ vesāliṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ:
an8.12:26.5: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā evamāha: anuviccakāraṃ kho sīha, karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
an8.12:26.6: esāhaṃ bhante, dutiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca,
an8.12:26.7: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an8.12:27.1: dīgharattaṃ kho te sīha, nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ yena tesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
an8.12:27.2: imināpahaṃ bhante, bhagavato bhīyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha:
an8.12:27.3: dīgharattaṃ kho te sīha, nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ yena tesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
an8.12:27.6: mayhameva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
an8.12:27.7: mayhameva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ,
an8.12:27.8: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalanti.
an8.12:27.9: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā nigaṇṭhesupi dāne samādapeti.
an8.12:27.11: esāhaṃ bhante tatiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi. dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
an8.12:27.12: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an8.12:28.1: atha kho bhagavā sīhassa senāpatissa ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathīdaṃ:
an8.12:28.2: dāna kathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
an8.12:28.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi:
an8.12:28.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
an8.12:28.6: evameva sīhassa senāpatissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.12:29.1: atha kho sīho senāpati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.12:29.2: adhivāsetu me bhante, bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
an8.12:29.4: atha kho sīho senāpati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.12:30.1: atha kho sīho senāpati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
an8.12:30.2: gaccha tvaṃ ambho purisa, pavattamaṃsaṃ jānāhīti.
an8.12:30.3: atha kho sīho senāpati tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi.
an8.12:31.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sīhassa senāpatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
an8.12:31.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā vesāliyaṃ rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti.
an8.12:31.3: ajja sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ.
an8.12:31.4: taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭicca kammanti.
an8.12:32.1: atha kho aññataro puriso yena sīho senāpati tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā sīhassa senāpatissa upakaṇṇake ārocesi.
an8.12:32.3: ete sambahulā nigaṇṭhā vesāliyaṃ rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti.
an8.12:32.4: ajja sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ,
an8.12:32.5: taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakammanti.
an8.12:32.6: alaṃ ayyo dīgharattampi te āyasmanto avaṇṇakāmā buddhassa, avaṇṇakāmā dhammassa, avaṇṇakāmā saṅghassa
an8.12:32.7: na ca panete āyasmanto jīranti taṃ bhagavantaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhantā,
an8.12:32.8: na ca mayaṃ jīvitahetūpi sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāmāti.
an8.12:33.1: atha kho sīho senāpati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi. sampavāresi.
an8.12:33.2: atha kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.12:33.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
